entities.name: Tin Street Market
entities.description: A bustling, chaotic bazaar in the Tenth District of Ravnica, a hub of trade, crime and intrigue.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane on which Tin Street Market lies.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: The notorious Tin Street Kingpin whose loyal goblins run rackets in the market.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A wojek officer who was dumped by his mother in the market and who survived the Aul House bombing.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: Agrus Kos's partner in arresting Mr. Gullmott.

entities.name: Gullmott
entities.description: An actor arrested for blocking part of the market with his troupe's tent.

entities.name: Yertrude
entities.description: Wife of silk merchant Wenvel Kolkin, who vanished and returned as a seeker ghost with her throat cut.

entities.name: Luda
entities.description: An orphan girl killed by a Rakdos cultist goblin in Berk's Alley.

entities.name: Saint Bayul
entities.description: A Selesnyan saint killed by a bomb at Aul House.

entities.name: Bell Borca
entities.description: Agrus Kos's partner, killed in the Aul House blast.

entities.name: Fonn Zunich
entities.description: A character present at Aul House who was removed to the Undercity and later investigated Zuza Uldossa's murder.

entities.name: Myczil Zunich
entities.description: A spirit who led Agrus Kos to the site of Luda's death.

entities.name: Jarad vod Savo
entities.description: A camouflaged figure who removed Fonn Zunich from the blast site to the Undercity.

entities.name: Zuza Uldossa
entities.description: The owner of an exotic pet shop, murdered in her shop.

entities.name: Dr. Helligan
entities.description: A doctor who examined Zuza's corpse, actually a Lupul in disguise.

entities.name: Modar Bejiri
entities.description: An Azorius vedalken court hussar who let a doppelganger kill him to take his shape and evade arrest.

entities.name: Ritjit
entities.description: A guildless ogre who destroyed most of the market stalls in a rampage.

entities.name: Bartek
entities.description: A character who bought a necklace at the market for the Bane-Alley Broker Andra.

entities.name: Andra
entities.description: The Bane-Alley Broker for whom Bartek bought a necklace.

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: A character who cried in an alley during the celebrations after the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Wyroon
entities.description: A minotaur tavern keeper ousted from the Boros Legion who runs the Millstone.

entities.name: Noggra
entities.description: A goblin alchemist who runs Noggra's Remedies.

entities.name: Falish
entities.description: A renegade Izzet toolsmith with connections to Krenko.

entities.name: Rakdos Cult
entities.description: The cult whose goblin members carried out the killings of Luda and the Aul House bombing.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: A guild whose banners of protection fly over many stalls.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The guild whose soldiers serve arrest writs.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon against whom Ravnica's heroes stood in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war after which Tin Street became a site of celebrations.

entities.name: Aul House
entities.description: A loxodon vegetarian cafe where Saint Bayul was mortally wounded.

entities.name: Berk's Alley
entities.description: A dark alley adjoining the market where Luda was killed.

events.summary: Agrus Kos and Feather publicly arrest Mr. Gullmott on stage during a production of the Signing of the Guildpact, and Yertrude vanishes from the audience, returning as a seeker ghost that Kos destroys.
events.quote: Kos and Feather very publicly arrested Mr. Gullmott while he was enraged and enchanted on-stage in a production of the Signing of the Guildpact .

events.summary: A goblin of the Cult of Rakdos kills the orphan girl Luda in an alley next to the market.
events.quote: a goblin member of the Cult of Rakdos killed the orphan girl Luda with a serrated dagger in an alley abutting the Tin Street Market.

events.summary: The goblin assassin detonates a bomb at Aul House, killing himself, Bayul and Borca; Kos survives and Fonn is removed to the Undercity by Jarad vod Savo.
events.quote: The goblin assassin then detonated a bomb, killing himself, Bayul, and Borca in the blast.

events.summary: Twelve years later Fonn investigates the murder of shop owner Zuza Uldossa, whose body is examined by Dr. Helligan, a Lupul in disguise.
events.quote: Fonn investigated another murder on the street, this time of shop owner Zuza Uldossa

events.summary: Modar Bejiri lets a doppelganger kill him and take his shape just as the arresting Azorius soldiers arrive.
events.quote: Modar let himself be killed by the creature who then took on his shape

events.summary: The guildless ogre Ritjit rampages through the market, destroying 81% of the stalls before being detained.
events.quote: he destroyed 81% of the Tin Street Market stalls in less than twenty minutes.

events.summary: Ritjit escapes his cell by smashing the door with the iron ball chained to his foot.
events.quote: He spent three years in a cell before smashing the door with the iron ball chained to his foot.

events.summary: After the War of the Spark, Tin Street fills with celebrations and Araithia Shokta cries in an alley.
events.quote: Tin Street became the site of numerous celebrations marking the hard-won victory.

relations.quote: Goblins loyal to Krenko , the notorious Tin Street Kingpin, prowl the alleys and rooftops

relations.note: A cultist goblin mortally wounded her at Aul House.
relations.quote: the Selesnyan Saint Bayul was mortally wounded by a Rakdos cultist goblin

relations.quote: Agrus was led by the spirit of Myczil Zunich to the site of her death

rejected.quote: who was ousted from the Boros Legion years ago for insubordination
